The '''military''' of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] (CIS) operated during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and subsequent [[Clone Wars/Legends|conflict]]. It had two main branches&mdash;the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], and the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]&mdash;but consisted of an amalgam of military forces from the various allied organizations of the Confederacy, with [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] as their infantry. The Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], held supreme authority at a ''civilian'' level as [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]], while military authority was chiefly under the purview of the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] and her successor General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. At the height of its power, the Confederate military was the most formidable military force in the [[Galaxy]].

The military was dissolved when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|killed]] the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] at the order of newly-crowned [[Emperor/Legends|''Emperor'']] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and subsequently gave the command for most of the droid forces to shut down. Later, the droids of the former Confederacy would be reactivated for the duration of [[Gizor Dellso]]'s [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|rebellion]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].

==History==
===Origins===
Though the severity of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] was not fully realized until [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], the militarization process of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and other [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] economic organizations had already been underway for the better part of a decade. The secretive schemes and machinations of then-[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;secretly, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious&mdash;had exacerbated existing tensions between the more developed [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core systems]] and the lawless frontiers of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="DarthP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Arguably the most significant of these events was the deployment of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] in the organization's [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade and subsequent invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], where the mettle of the droid soldiers was tested on a large scale for the first time.<ref name="Ep1">{{Film|I}}</ref>

Soon after these events, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] became disillusioned with both the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] itself and departed from both to claim his birthright as a [[Count/Legends|Count]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].<ref name="DarthP" /> In his new position of authority, Dooku began to rally the disparate economic and trading bodies of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and Trade Federation, among others, into an [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|alliance]] in opposition to Republic policies and governance. And along the way, the militarized forces of these groups were amalgamated into a unified military for the new Confederacy.<ref name="DarthP" /><ref name="Ep2">{{Film|II}}</ref>

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|If you think the Republic has strayed from the path of benevolence and wisdom, wait until you experience government by battle droid.|Jedi General Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}} 
{{Main|Clone Wars/Legends}}
[[File:CIS_Troops.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Organic soldiers were also part of the Confederancy's army.]]
The military build-up and increasing hostility of the Confederacy&mdash;driven in no small part by Dooku himself, who had become [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] apprentice to Darth Sidious&mdash;came to a head in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. As a foundry planet for the manufacturing of countless [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], the appearance of Jedi and Republic forces on the planet were the spark which ignited the powder keg that was the Separatist Crisis. At the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the Clone Wars erupted in earnest, with the Republic's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|army]] clashing in open conflict with the droid armies of the Confederacy for the first time.<ref name="Ep2" />

Though the battle at Geonosis would be a defeat for the Separatist Alliance, their military would go on to be an effective fighting force for the remainder of the war. For the three years of the conflict, the Separatist military would fight in hundreds of battles across the galaxy, matching the Republic's forces in many respects. Many of the Confederate military's victories came from the leadership of their [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], the dreaded [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

[[File:B-series_battle_droids.jpg|thumb|left|350px|The B-series line of battle droids made up the bulk of the Confederacy military.]]
The droid armies under Grievous' command would lead many daring and devastating assaults on Republic holdings, culminating with an [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|assault]] on the Republic capital, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During this particular engagement, the forces of the Confederate military were able to briefly capture [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine before he was rescued by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;with Count Dooku killed in the process.<ref name="Ep3" />

===End of the war===
With the Confederate Head of State dead, the droid army under Grievous effectively became the ''de facto'' ruling body of the entire Separatist movement. Shortly afterward, on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], Grievous was killed in single combat with Kenobi, leaving the Confederacy devoid of both civilian and military leadership; and placing rulership of the movement in the hands of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="Ep3" />

Even as the droid armies continued to battle for [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], and a number of other worlds, their fight came to an unexpected end. Anakin Skywalker&mdash;now Darth Vader, Sith apprentice to newly-[[Emperor/Legends|''Emperor'']] Palpatine&mdash;killed the members of the Separatist Council on Mustafar at the behest of his new master, and broadcast the shut-down order for most of the Separatists' armies.<ref name="Ep3" /> Across the galaxy, in an instant, the military of the Confederacy of Independent Systems ceased to exist.

===Historical impact and legacy===
[[File:Sankar_Palace_BX_Commando_Droid_CotG.png|thumb|right|200px|A BX commando droid continues to guard Sankar Palace on Cato Neimoidia decades after the Clone Wars.]]
The unprecedented build-up of the Separatists' droid armies and navy had a number of ramifications, both immediate and long-term. Identifying the impending threat, Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]], without the authorization of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], ordered the production of an army of clone soldiers in the cloning facilities of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="DarthP" /><ref name="Ep2" /> In the short term, this led to both the Clone Wars themselves, but also served to ultimately undermine the moral authority of the Jedi Order itself.<ref name="Ep3" /><ref name="Order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

In the longer term, the build-up of the Confederacy's droid army and navy led directly to the massive re-militarization of the Republic and its successor state, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Without the threat of the Confederate military to urge the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] on, there would have been little incentive for the creation of the clone army or the growth of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. When the droid armies were deactivated, the new Empire was left in a position of uncontested dominance, with the Grand Army of the Republic and Republic Navy being reorganized into the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], respectively.

The new ''Imperial'' forces and the droids of the defunct Confederacy would go on to clash at least twice more. During the [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|rebellion]] of [[Gizor Dellso]] on Mustafar, battle droids would be reactivated and fight the Imperial forces for a period, before being defeated once more.<ref name="Battlefront2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> In addition, [[Fortressa|at least one]] of the Trade Federation's ''Lucrehulk''-class battleships would eventually find its way into the hands of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], before it too was destroyed by [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|the Imperial military]].<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

==Makeup==
===Leadership===
[[File:GrievousTamborDookuGunray.png|thumb|left|300px|General Grievous, Wat Tambor, Count Dooku, and Nute Gunray all acted as major military leaders.]]
As head of the Confederate state, Count Dooku held ultimate authority over the direction of the CIS military's efforts, commanding general overall strategy.

Dooku, however, was also responsible for maintaining civilian authority of the CIS, and so many of the main military responsibilities were delegated to his generals and [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]]. Chief amongst these was the General Sev'rance Tann and her successor Grievous, who carried the rank of Supreme Commander of the Droid Army.<ref name="Eyes" /><ref name="Ep3" /> Under Grievous served a number of other high-ranking generals, including [[Durge/Legends|Durge]], [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and a number of others.

===Army===
{{Main|Separatist Droid Army/Legends}}
[[File:Battle_droids_EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|270px|B1 battle droids of the Separatist Droid Army]]
Perhaps the largest droid army ever assembled, the army of the CIS outnumbered the clone soldiers of the Republic 100 to 1.<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref> The army was cobbled together from the droid soldiers of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]],<ref name="DB-Commerce Guild">{{DB|organization|ca_tankdroid|Commerce Guild}}</ref> the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]],<ref name="Ep3Vis">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> the InterGalactic Banking Clan,<ref name="Ep2Vis">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> the Techno Union,<ref name="DB-Techno Union">{{DB|organization|technounion|Techno Union}}</ref> and the Trade Federation<ref name="Ep2Vis" />

Though the Confederacy made use of a wide variety of droid soldiers, chief amongst these were the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] and the ubiquitous [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], which saw combat in countless theatres of war.

===Navy===
{{Main|Confederate Navy/Legends}}
[[File:Grievous_Battle_of_Bothawui.png|thumb|left|240px|General Grievous leads a Separatist fleet during the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]].]]
As with the army, the Confederate Navy was an amalgam of the militaries from which it originated. In spite of this, however, the backbone of the navy was comprised of a relatively small number of capital ship classes, including [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]], [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]], [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleships]] and their [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|droid control variants]], as well as their [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing crafts]]. The fleet was led, until its destruction at the Battle of Coruscant, by the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].<ref name="Ep3" /><ref name="Ep2" /><ref name="Ep3novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

The capital ship fleet was augmented by its legions of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], which were composed largely of [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]] and, in particular, [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class]] droid starfighters.

The Confederate Navy was also home to a number of experimental [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] throughout the war. One of these was the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], a massive [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] equipped with a pair of [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]] designed to disable Republic capital ships.<ref name="RisingM">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref><ref name="ShadowM">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> The ''Malevolence'' was later destroyed at the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]].<ref name="DestroyM">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
